revisions.summary: Rewritten after the slowed entry's reading, timed on this cut's own audio. The opening voice is now a line of very light catches, and the lighter replies continue through the rest of the piece under strong downstrokes. This changed more than a touch-up.

points.text: The exposed voice in very light catches, the biggest lift on the vowel at 5.9 s.
From here the upper figure crosses the kicks in five positions, as in the slowed entry.
